source: Smithsonian GVP Holocene eruptions (WFS) + NOAA NCEI significant volcanic eruptions (paroxysm dates, deaths)
notes: v = row index in volcanoes.json. vei -1 = unknown. flags: 1 uncertain eruption, 2 VEI uncertain, 4 start year uncertain/approximate, 8 climax date (cy/cm/cd) from NCEI. yu = year uncertainty (years). Years are astronomical (0 = 1 BC, -4999 = 5000 BC). Month/day 0 = unknown. Dates are kept as recorded by the source (Julian before 1582-10-15, as is conventional in the catalogues); the game calendar is proleptic Gregorian.
